description: This PHP source file defines the EmrClient class within the Aws\Emr namespace. It serves as a client for interacting with the Amazon Elastic MapReduce (Amazon EMR) service, providing a set of methods corresponding to EMR API actions, including both synchronous and asynchronous variants.

classes.name: EmrClient
classes.description: A client to interact with the Amazon EMR service, extending the base AwsClient class and providing numerous methods for managing EMR clusters, steps, security configurations, and related resources.

methods.name: addInstanceFleet
methods.description: Adds an instance fleet to an existing EMR cluster.

methods.name: addInstanceFleetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds an instance fleet to an existing EMR cluster.

methods.name: addInstanceGroups
methods.description: Adds one or more instance groups to a cluster.

methods.name: addInstanceGroupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds one or more instance groups to a cluster.

methods.name: addJobFlowSteps
methods.description: Adds steps to a Hadoop streaming job on EMR.

methods.name: addJobFlowStepsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds steps to a Hadoop streaming job.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to an EMR resource.

methods.name: addTagsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to an EMR resource.

methods.name: cancelSteps
methods.description: Cancels specified steps in a cluster.

methods.name: cancelStepsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels specified steps in a cluster.

methods.name: createStudioSessionMapping
methods.description: Creates a session mapping for a Studio.

methods.name: createStudioSessionMappingAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a session mapping for a Studio.

methods.name: deleteStudioSessionMapping
methods.description: Deletes a session mapping for a Studio.

methods.name: deleteStudioSessionMappingAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a session mapping for a Studio.

methods.name: describeCluster
methods.description: Returns details of a specific EMR cluster.

methods.name: describeClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously returns details of a specific EMR cluster.

methods.name: describeJobFlowsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously returns descriptions of job flows.

methods.name: describeNotebookExecution
methods.description: Returns information about a notebook execution.

methods.name: describeNotebookExecutionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously returns information about a notebook execution.

methods.name: describeReleaseLabel
methods.description: Describes the release label for EMR.

methods.name: describeReleaseLabelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes the release label for EMR.

methods.name: describeSecurityConfiguration
methods.description: Returns details of a security configuration.

methods.name: describeSecurityConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously returns details of a security configuration.

methods.name: describeStep
methods.description: Provides details about a specific step.

methods.name: describeStepAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously provides details about a specific step.

methods.name: describeStudioAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously returns details about a Studio.

methods.name: getAutoTerminationPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the auto termination policy for a cluster.

methods.name: getAutoTerminationPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the auto termination policy.

methods.name: getBlockPublicAccessConfiguration
methods.description: Gets the block public access configuration.

methods.name: getBlockPublicAccessConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets the block public access configuration.

methods.name: getClusterSessionCredentials
methods.description: Gets session credentials for a cluster.

methods.name: getClusterSessionCredentialsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets session credentials for a cluster.

methods.name: getManagedScalingPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the managed scaling policy of a cluster.

methods.name: getManagedScalingPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the managed scaling policy.

methods.name: getStudioSessionMapping
methods.description: Gets session mapping details for a Studio.

methods.name: getStudioSessionMappingAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets session mapping details for a Studio.

methods.name: listBootstrapActions
methods.description: Lists bootstrap actions for a cluster.

methods.name: listInstanceFleets
methods.description: Lists instance fleets for a cluster.

methods.name: putAutoScalingPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates an auto-scaling policy.

methods.name: putAutoScalingPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates an auto-scaling policy.

methods.name: putAutoTerminationPolicy
methods.description: Sets auto-termination policy for a cluster.

methods.name: putBlockPublicAccessConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the block public access setting.

methods.name: putManagedScalingPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates a managed scaling policy.

methods.name: putManagedScalingPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a managed scaling policy.

methods.name: removeManagedScalingPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes a managed scaling policy.

methods.name: removeTags
methods.description: Removes tags from an EMR resource.

methods.name: runJobFlow
methods.description: Runs a new job flow (cluster) on EMR.

methods.name: runJobFlowAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously runs a new job flow.

methods.name: setKeepJobFlowAliveWhenNoSteps
methods.description: Sets whether the cluster should remain active when no steps are running.

methods.name: setTerminationProtection
methods.description: Sets termination protection on a cluster.

methods.name: setVisibleToAllUsers
methods.description: Sets the visibility of a Studio to all users.

methods.name: terminateJobFlows
methods.description: Terminates one or more job flows (clusters).

methods.name: updateStudioSessionMapping
methods.description: Updates a session mapping for a Studio.

methods.name: updateStudioSessionMappingAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a session mapping for a Studio.
